rows.note: Use 歌 as the all-purpose spoken choice when the tune means a song.

example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 teng1

rows.note: Use 樂曲 for a short musical composition, especially an instrumental or formal piece rather than a song.

example.english: This tune was written specially for a string orchestra.
example.traditional: 呢首樂曲係專為弦樂團而寫嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 ngok6 kuk1 hai6 zyun1 wai6 jin4 ngok6 tyun4 ji4 se2 ge3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for adjusting a machine or device so that it works better.

example.english: Tune the air conditioner better and it’ll save electricity.
example.traditional: 部冷氣調校好啲就慳電喇。
example.jyutping: bou6 laang5 hei3 tiu4 haau3 hou2 di1 zau6 haan1 din6 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when adjusting a musical instrument to produce the correct pitches.

example.english: We need to tune the guitar before the band’s performance.
example.traditional: 樂隊演出前，要幫把結他調音。
example.jyutping: ngok6 deoi6 jin2 ceot1 cin4 jiu3 bong1 baa2 git3 taa1 tiu4 jam1

rows.note: Use 調 for the melody or musical air rather than the whole song.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 ni1 go3 diu6

rows.note: Use this for setting a radio or television to a particular channel or frequency.

example.english: Tune my radio to channel eight.
example.traditional: 幫我將部收音機調到八台。
example.jyutping: bong1 ngo5 zoeng1 bou6 sau1 jam1 gei1 tiu4 dou3 baat3 toi4

rows.note: Use 保養 for a vehicle or engine service that includes tuning and maintenance.

example.english: The engine runs much more smoothly after a tune and service.
example.traditional: 部車做完保養之後，引擎順咗好多。
example.jyutping: bou6 ce1 zou6 jyun4 bou2 joeng5 zi1 hau6 jan5 king4 seon6 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when deliberately directing your attention or senses toward particular sounds or other information.

example.english: Tune in to the storm updates in the weather report.
example.traditional: 聽天氣報告時，要留心風暴消息。
example.jyutping: teng1 tin1 hei3 bou3 gou3 si4 jiu3 lau4 sam1 fung1 bou6 siu1 sik1
